Ansvar Gateway.description: Regulatory primary sources served verbatim — EU regulations (GDPR, AI Act, CRA, NIS2, DORA, MiCA, MDR) with their delegated and implementing acts, national law across 28 audited jurisdictions in Europe and the United States (including US CFR sector titles and UK legislation), UN vehicle regulations, and regulator guidance — every result carries an item-level source citation (source URL, publisher, license); fails closed instead of answering without a source.
